items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: I'd get, uh, like, like Jabril Smith on, or, or some of the Columbia records

ctx.x: I loved the sound of the way Bix played and everything else, see. Yeah. And, uh, it was, it was just wonderful. You know, Dick Boynard and all the guys and, uh, like I say, I mean, I had a collection of those kind of records. And then sometimes I'd get, uh, like, like Jabril Smith on, or, or some of the Columbia records or the Carriers or something like that, see. Mm-hmm. But, uh, that's the, that's the kind of records that I listen to. Mm-hmm. Um, I didn't have too many Victor records, because Victor at that…
Oh, yeah. You reminded me of something when you mentioned Jabba. Did they have a band at Smalls Paradise, or just a piano player, or what?
